cohort: 1098 women with placenta previa undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: In women with placenta previa undergoing cesarean delivery, transverse skin incision was associated with lower estimated blood loss, postpartum hemorrhage, maternal intensive care unit admission, blood transfusion, and 5-minute APGAR score < 7, compared to vertical skin incision.
mod_finding: Transverse skin incision was associated with better perinatal outcomes compared to vertical skin incision in women with placenta previa undergoing cesarean delivery.
